# zentral_mdm_software_update_enforcement (Resource)

The resource `zentral_mdm_software_update_enforcement` manages MDM software update enforcements.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The macOS 26 devices get the latest macOS 26 update
resource "zentral_mdm_software_update_enforcement" "macos_26" {
  name                  = "macOS 26"
  platforms             = ["macOS"]
  min_device_os_version = "26"
  max_device_os_version = "27"
  max_os_version        = "27"
}

# The macOS 27 devices get the latest macOS 27 update
resource "zentral_mdm_software_update_enforcement" "macos_27" {
  name                  = "macOS 27"
  platforms             = ["macOS"]
  min_device_os_version = "27"
  max_device_os_version = "28"
  max_os_version        = "28"
}

# The tag that moves a device to macOS 27
resource "zentral_tag" "upgrade_27" {
  name = "upgrade-27"
}

# The tagged devices are upgraded to the latest macOS 27 update, whatever their OS version.
# The tags rank before the device OS version range, so this enforcement wins over "macOS 26"
# for a tagged macOS 26 device, and keeps winning for as long as the device has the tag.
# Remove the tag after the upgrade: the device falls under "macOS 27".
resource "zentral_mdm_software_update_enforcement" "upgrade_27" {
  name           = "Upgrade to macOS 27"
  platforms      = ["macOS"]
  tag_ids        = [zentral_tag.upgrade_27.id]
  max_os_version = "28"
}

# The three enforcements in one blueprint
resource "zentral_mdm_blueprint" "default" {
  name = "Default"
  software_update_enforcement_ids = [
    zentral_mdm_software_update_enforcement.macos_26.id,
    zentral_mdm_software_update_enforcement.macos_27.id,
    zentral_mdm_software_update_enforcement.upgrade_27.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the software update enforcement.
- `platforms` (Set of String) Restrict the software update enforcement to some platforms. Valid values are `macOS`, `iOS`, `iPadOS` and `tvOS`.

### Optional

- `build_version` (String) The target build version to update the device to by the appropriate time.
- `delay_days` (Number) Number of days after a software update release before the device force installs it.
- `details_url` (String) The URL of a web page that shows details that the organization provides about the enforced update.
- `local_datetime` (String) The local date time value that specifies when to force install the software update.
- `local_time` (String) The local time value that specifies when to force install the software update.
- `max_device_os_version` (String) Only the devices with an OS version lower than this version are enforced. A version with at most three components, such as `27` or `27.1`. Requires Zentral `v2026.6` or later.
- `max_os_version` (String) The maximum (excluded) target OS version to update the device to by the appropriate time.
- `min_device_os_version` (String) Only the devices with an OS version greater than or equal to this version are enforced. A version with at most three components, such as `26` or `26.3.1`. Requires Zentral `v2026.6` or later.
- `os_version` (String) The target OS version to update the device to by the appropriate time.
- `tag_ids` (Set of Number) The `ID`s of the tags used to scope the software update enforcement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) `ID` of the software update enforcement.
